otherWay.text: Owner cash in the latest 12 months was 21.8% of revenue, above the 3.0% line.
The company paid $23.1 billion to buy back shares over the period.

shareReason: share count jumps in one year (a stock split, or a conversion at listing); not adjusted
summary: From fiscal 2007 to 2025, Netflix, Inc. reported $290.6 billion of revenue and $17.6 billion of free cash flow. Stock pay was $4.0 billion, which leaves $13.6 billion of owner cash: 4.7% of revenue.
Owner cash was under 3.0% of revenue in 9 of 19 years.
In the 12 months to 2026-09-30 it was 21.8% of revenue.
